summary.text: Regina Birdsell is a Republican state senator from New Hampshire who has represented District 19 since December 2014 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia's 2026 election page lists her as Senate Majority Leader.

paragraphs.text: Birdsell served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Rockingham 13 from 2010 to 2014 and assumed office in the State Senate on December 3, 2014.
In the 2025-2026 session she serves on the Senate Finance Committee and the Health and Human Services Committee.
